import sys

def solve():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    N = data[0]
    A = data[1:]
    del data

    P = [0] * (N + 1)
    seen = bytearray(N + 1)
    cnt = 0
    for i, x in enumerate(A):
        if not seen[x]:
            seen[x] = 1
            cnt += 1
        P[i + 1] = cnt

    suf = [0] * (N + 1)
    seen = bytearray(N + 1)
    cnt = 0
    for i in range(N - 1, -1, -1):
        x = A[i]
        if not seen[x]:
            seen[x] = 1
            cnt += 1
        suf[i] = cnt
    del seen

    NEG = -10**9
    size = 1
    log = 0
    while size < N:
        size <<= 1
        log += 1

    d = [NEG] * (2 * size)
    lz = [0] * size

    last = [-1] * (N + 1)
    last[A[0]] = 0
    ans = 0

    for idx in range(1, N - 1):
        x = A[idx]
        p = last[x]
        l = p + 1
        if l < 1:
            l = 1

        if l < idx:
            L = l + size
            R = idx + size
            L0 = L
            R0 = R
            while L < R:
                if L & 1:
                    d[L] += 1
                    if L < size:
                        lz[L] += 1
                    L += 1
                if R & 1:
                    R -= 1
                    d[R] += 1
                    if R < size:
                        lz[R] += 1
                L >>= 1
                R >>= 1

            k1 = L0 >> 1
            k2 = (R0 - 1) >> 1
            while k1:
                c = k1 << 1
                lv = d[c]
                rv = d[c | 1]
                d[k1] = lz[k1] + (lv if lv >= rv else rv)
                if k2 != k1:
                    c = k2 << 1
                    lv = d[c]
                    rv = d[c | 1]
                    d[k2] = lz[k2] + (lv if lv >= rv else rv)
                k1 >>= 1
                k2 >>= 1

        pos = size + idx
        d[pos] = P[idx] + 1
        pos >>= 1
        while pos:
            c = pos << 1
            lv = d[c]
            rv = d[c | 1]
            # lz[pos] is zero on this path (newly activated leaf)
            d[pos] = lv if lv >= rv else rv
            pos >>= 1

        v = d[1] + suf[idx + 1]
        if v > ans:
            ans = v
        last[x] = idx

    sys.stdout.write(str(ans) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
```

def prime_factor_sum(p, arr):
    g=0

            H += a

                    v = dp1[h]

import sys
import heapq

def solve():
    input = sys.stdin.buffer.readline
    N_K = input().split()
    if not N_K:
        return
    N = int(N_K[0]); K = int(N_K[1])
    A = list(map(int, input().split()))
    B = list(map(int, input().split()))
    C = list(map(int, input().split()))
    if K == 1:
        a = max(A); b = max(B); c = max(C)
        print(a*b + b*c + c*a)
        return
    A.sort(reverse=True)
    B.sort(reverse=True)
    C.sort(reverse=True)
    N1 = N - 1
    dA = [A[i] - A[i+1] for i in range(N1)]
    dB = [B[i] - B[i+1] for i in range(N1)]
    dC = [C[i] - C[i+1] for i in range(N1)]
    SHIFT = max(1, N1.bit_length())
    MASK = (1 << SHIFT) - 1
    SHIFT2 = SHIFT * 2
    STEP_I = 1 << SHIFT2
    STEP_J = 1 << SHIFT
    A0 = A[0]
    val0 = A0*B[0] + B[0]*C[0] + C[0]*A0
    heap = [(-val0, 0, 0)]
    heappop = heapq.heappop
    heappush = heapq.heappush
    # local bindings
    A_list = A; B_list = B; C_list = C
    dA_list = dA; dB_list = dB; dC_list = dC
    N1_local = N1; MASK_local = MASK; SHIFT_local = SHIFT; SHIFT2_local = SHIFT2
    STEP_I_local = STEP_I; STEP_J_local = STEP_J; A0_local = A0
    for _ in range(K - 1):
        neg, s, code = heappop(heap)
        i = code >> SHIFT2_local
        if i == N1_local:
            continue
        val = -neg
        k = code & MASK_local
        j = (code >> SHIFT_local) & MASK_local
        ns = s + 1
        if i == 0:
            b = B_list[j]
            c = C_list[k]
            nv = val - dA_list[i] * (b + c)
            heappush(heap, (-nv, ns, code + STEP_I_local))
            if j < N1_local:
                nv = val - dB_list[j] * (A0_local + c)
                heappush(heap, (-nv, ns, code + STEP_J_local))
            if j == 0 and k < N1_local:
                nv = val - dC_list[k] * (A0_local + b)
                heappush(heap, (-nv, ns, code + 1))
        else:
            nv = val - dA_list[i] * (B_list[j] + C_list[k])
            heappush(heap, (-nv, ns, code + STEP_I_local))
    print(-heap[0][0])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
```

import sys
from heapq import heappush, heappop

def solve():
    input = sys.stdin.buffer.readline
    line = input().split()
    if not line:
        return
    N = int(line[0]); K = int(line[1])
    A = list(map(int, input().split()))
    B = list(map(int, input().split()))
    C = list(map(int, input().split()))

    if K == 1:
        a = max(A); b = max(B); c = max(C)
        print(a*b + b*c + c*a)
        return

    A.sort(reverse=True)
    B.sort(reverse=True)
    C.sort(reverse=True)

    N1 = N - 1
    A0 = A[0]
    B0 = B[0]
    C0 = C[0]
    val0 = A0*B0 + B0*C0 + C0*A0

    dA = [A[i] - A[i+1] for i in range(N1)]
    del A
    dB = [B[i] - B[i+1] for i in range(N1)]
    dC = [C[i] - C[i+1] for i in range(N1)]

    SHIFT = max(1, N1.bit_length())
    MASK = (1 << SHIFT) - 1
    SHIFT2 = SHIFT * 2
    STEP_I = 1 << SHIFT2
    STEP_J = 1 << SHIFT

    heap = [(-val0, 0, 0)]
    push = heappush
    pop = heappop

    B_list = B
    C_list = C
    dA_list = dA
    dB_list = dB
    dC_list = dC
    N1_local = N1
    MASK_local = MASK
    SHIFT_local = SHIFT
    SHIFT2_local = SHIFT2
    STEP_I_local = STEP_I
    STEP_J_local = STEP_J
    A0_local = A0

    for _ in range(K - 1):
        neg, s, code = pop(heap)
        i = code >> SHIFT2_local
        if i == N1_local:
            continue
        val = -neg
        k = code & MASK_local
        j = (code >> SHIFT_local) & MASK_local
        ns = s + 1
        if i == 0:
            b = B_list[j]
            c = C_list[k]
            nv = val - dA_list[0] * (b + c)
            push(heap, (-nv, ns, code + STEP_I_local))
            if j < N1_local:
                nv = val - dB_list[j] * (A0_local + c)
                push(heap, (-nv, ns, code + STEP_J_local))
            if j == 0 and k < N1_local:
                nv = val - dC_list[k] * (A0_local + b)
                push(heap, (-nv, ns, code + 1))
        else:
            nv = val - dA_list[i] * (B_list[j] + C_list[k])
            push(heap, (-nv, ns, code + STEP_I_local))

    print(-heap[0][0])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
```

import sys
from array import array

MOD = 998244353


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().split()
    if not data:
        return
    W, H, L, R, D, U = map(int, data)
    mod = MOD

    # Maximum n needed for binomial coefficients.
    N = W + H + 4

    # factorials modulo MOD (n < MOD always holds here)
    fact = array('I', [1]) * (N + 1)
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % mod

    comb_cache = {}

    def C(n, k):
        if n < 0 or k < 0 or k > n:
            return 0
        if k > n - k:
            k = n - k
        key = (n, k)
        if key in comb_cache:
            return comb_cache[key]
        # Since n < MOD, fact values are invertible.
        res = fact[n] * pow(fact[k] * fact[n - k] % mod, mod - 2, mod) % mod
        comb_cache[key] = res
        return res

    # Sum_{p=1..A} Sum_{q=1..B} C(p+q, p)
    def S(A, B):
        if A <= 0 or B <= 0:
            return 0
        return (C(A + B + 2, A + 1) - A - B - 2) % mod

    def rect_sum(P1, P2, Q1, Q2):
        if P1 > P2 or Q1 > Q2:
            return 0
        return (S(P2, Q2) - S(P1 - 1, Q2) - S(P2, Q1 - 1) + S(P1 - 1, Q1 - 1)) % mod

    # Number of monotone paths in a full (w+1) x (h+1) grid,
    # with arbitrary start and end, including length 0.
    def total_all(w, h):
        if w < 0 or h < 0:
            return 0
        return (S(w + 1, h + 1) - (w + 1) * (h + 1)) % mod

    # Full-grid paths whose start and end are both allowed.
    total = total_all(W, H)
    n_forbidden = ((R - L + 1) * (U - D + 1)) % mod

    start_in_forbidden = (
        rect_sum(W - R + 1, W - L + 1, H - U + 1, H - D + 1) - n_forbidden
    ) % mod

    end_in_forbidden = (
        rect_sum(L + 1, R + 1, D + 1, U + 1) - n_forbidden
    ) % mod

    both_in_forbidden = total_all(R - L, U - D)

    allowed_full = (total - start_in_forbidden - end_in_forbidden + both_in_forbidden) % mod

    # Subtract paths that hit the forbidden rectangle.
    # Count by the first forbidden point entered.
    bad = 0

    if D > 0 or L > 0:
        # Common suffix counts for the corner (L, D).
        s1_init = C(W - L + H - D + 2, W - L + 1)
        s2_init = C(R - L + U - D + 2, R - L + 1)

        need_inv = (D > 0 and R > L) or (L > 0 and U > D)
        if need_inv:
            inv = [0] * (N + 1)
            inv[1] = 1
            for i in range(2, N + 1):
                inv[i] = mod - (mod // i) * inv[mod % i] % mod
            inv_local = inv
        else:
            inv_local = []

        # First entry from below: (x, D-1) -> (x, D), x = L..R
        if D > 0:
            bb = C(L + D + 1, D)          # binomial part of dp(L, D-1) + 1
            s1 = s1_init
            s2 = s2_init

            c_bb = D + 2
            c_s1_num = W + 1
            c_s1_den = W + H - D + 2
            c_s2_num = R + 1
            c_s2_den = R + U - D + 2

            acc = 0
            for x in range(L, R):
                acc += (bb - 1) * (s1 - s2)
                bb = (bb * (x + c_bb) * inv_local[x + 2]) % mod
                s1 = (s1 * (c_s1_num - x) * inv_local[c_s1_den - x]) % mod
                s2 = (s2 * (c_s2_num - x) * inv_local[c_s2_den - x]) % mod
            acc += (bb - 1) * (s1 - s2)
            bad = (bad + acc) % mod

        # First entry from the left: (L-1, y) -> (L, y), y = D..U
        if L > 0:
            bb = C(L + D + 1, L)          # binomial part of dp(L-1, D) + 1
            s1 = s1_init
            s2 = s2_init

            c_bb = L + 2
            c_s1_num = H + 1
            c_s1_den = W - L + H + 2
            c_s2_num = U + 1
            c_s2_den = R - L + U + 2

            acc = 0
            for y in range(D, U):
                acc += (bb - 1) * (s1 - s2)
                bb = (bb * (y + c_bb) * inv_local[y + 2]) % mod
                s1 = (s1 * (c_s1_num - y) * inv_local[c_s1_den - y]) % mod
                s2 = (s2 * (c_s2_num - y) * inv_local[c_s2_den - y]) % mod
            acc += (bb - 1) * (s1 - s2)
            bad = (bad + acc) % mod

    ans = (allowed_full - bad) % mod
    print(ans)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys
from array import array
MOD=998244353

def main():
    W,H,L,R,D,U = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    N = W + H + 5
    fact = array('I', [1]) * (N + 1)
    mod = MOD
    for i in range(1, N+1):
        fact[i] = (fact[i-1] * i) % mod
    cache = {}
    def C(n,k):
        if n < 0 or k < 0 or k > n:
            return 0
        if k > n-k:
            k = n-k
        key = (n,k)
        res = cache.get(key)
        if res is not None:
            return res
        res = fact[n] * pow(fact[k] * fact[n-k] % mod, mod-2, mod) % mod
        cache[key] = res
        return res
    def S(A,B):
        if A <= 0 or B <= 0:
            return 0
        return (C(A+B+2, A+1) - A - B - 2) % mod
    def rect_sum(P1,P2,Q1,Q2):
        if P1 > P2 or Q1 > Q2:
            return 0
        return (S(P2,Q2) - S(P1-1,Q2) - S(P2,Q1-1) + S(P1-1,Q1-1)) % mod
    def total_all(w,h):
        if w < 0 or h < 0:
            return 0
        return (S(w+1,h+1) - (w+1)*(h+1)) % mod
    total = total_all(W,H)
    nF = ((R-L+1) * (U-D+1)) % mod
    start_in = (rect_sum(W-R+1, W-L+1, H-U+1, H-D+1) - nF) % mod
    end_in = (rect_sum(L+1, R+1, D+1, U+1) - nF) % mod
    both_in = total_all(R-L, U-D)
    allowed_full = (total - start_in - end_in + both_in) % mod
    bad = 0
    if D > 0 or L > 0:
        inv = [0] * (N + 1)
        if N >= 1:
            inv[1] = 1
        for i in range(2, N+1):
            inv[i] = mod - (mod // i) * inv[mod % i] % mod
        inv_local = inv
        if D > 0:
            bb = C(L + D + 1, D)
            s1 = C(W - L + H - D + 2, H - D)
            s2 = C(R - L + U - D + 2, U - D)
            c_bb = D + 2
            c_s1_num = W + 2
            c_s1_den = W + H - D + 2
            c_s2_num = R + 2
            c_s2_den = R + U - D + 2
            acc = 0
            # local constants for speed
            for x in range(L, R):
                acc += (bb - 1) * (s1 - s2)
                bb = (bb * (x + c_bb) * inv_local[x + 2]) % mod
                s1 = (s1 * (c_s1_num - x) * inv_local[c_s1_den - x]) % mod
                s2 = (s2 * (c_s2_num - x) * inv_local[c_s2_den - x]) % mod
            acc += (bb - 1) * (s1 - s2)
            bad = (bad + acc) % mod
        if L > 0:
            bb = C(L + D + 1, L)
            s1 = C(W - L + H - D + 2, H - D)
            s2 = C(R - L + U - D + 2, U - D)
            c_bb = L + 2
            c_s1_num = H + 1
            c_s1_den = W - L + H + 2
            c_s2_num = U + 1
            c_s2_den = R - L + U + 2
            acc = 0
            for y in range(D, U):
                acc += (bb - 1) * (s1 - s2)
                bb = (bb * (y + c_bb) * inv_local[y + 2]) % mod
                s1 = (s1 * (c_s1_num - y) * inv_local[c_s1_den - y]) % mod
                s2 = (s2 * (c_s2_num - y) * inv_local[c_s2_den - y]) % mod
            acc += (bb - 1) * (s1 - s2)
            bad = (bad + acc) % mod
    ans = (allowed_full - bad) % mod
    print(ans)
if __name__ == '__main__': main()

import sys
from operator import itemgetter


def solve():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    t = data[0]
    idx = 1
    out = []

    INF = 10**30
    NEG = -10**30

    for _case in range(t):
        N = data[idx]
        K = data[idx + 1]
        idx += 2

        items = []
        for _ in range(N):
            x = data[idx]
            y = data[idx + 1]
            z = data[idx + 2]
            idx += 3

            m = x
            if y > m:
                m = y
            if z > m:
                m = z
            items.append((m, x, y, z))

        need = 2 * K
        outside_count = N - need

        # If we need all cakes, their order is irrelevant.
        if need < N:
            items.sort(key=itemgetter(0), reverse=True)

        # It is sufficient to replace at most two cakes from the top 2K cakes.
        max_u = 2 if outside_count >= 2 else outside_count
        size = (max_u + 1) * 8
        limit_unselect = max_u * 8

        # dp[u * 8 + mask]:
        #   minimum loss from the sum of max-values of the top 2K cakes,
        #   after unselecting u of them, with color parity mask.
        dp = [INF] * size
        dp[0] = 0

        sum_m = 0

        for j in range(need):
            m, x, y, z = items[j]
            sum_m += m

            l0 = m - x
            l1 = m - y
            l2 = m - z

            ndp = [INF] * size

            for i, cur in enumerate(dp):
                if cur == INF:
                    continue

                # Select this cake and assign it to X/Y/Z.
                v = cur + l0
                ni = i ^ 1
                if v < ndp[ni]:
                    ndp[ni] = v

                v = cur + l1
                ni = i ^ 2
                if v < ndp[ni]:
                    ndp[ni] = v

                v = cur + l2
                ni = i ^ 4
                if v < ndp[ni]:
                    ndp[ni] = v

                # Unselect this cake (only if we still may replace it).
                if i < limit_unselect:
                    v = cur + m
                    ni = i + 8
                    if v < ndp[ni]:
                        ndp[ni] = v

            dp = ndp

        # Best values obtainable by selecting 1 or 2 cakes from outside the top 2K.
        best1 = [NEG, NEG, NEG]  # one outside cake, parity is one bit
        best2 = [NEG] * 8        # two outside cakes, parity mask

        for j in range(need, N):
            m, x, y, z = items[j]

            # Pair current cake with a previous outside cake.
            b = best1[0]
            if b != NEG:
                v = b + x
                if v > best2[0]:
                    best2[0] = v
                v = b + y
                if v > best2[3]:
                    best2[3] = v
                v = b + z
                if v > best2[5]:
                    best2[5] = v

            b = best1[1]
            if b != NEG:
                v = b + x
                if v > best2[3]:
                    best2[3] = v
                v = b + y
                if v > best2[0]:
                    best2[0] = v
                v = b + z
                if v > best2[6]:
                    best2[6] = v

            b = best1[2]
            if b != NEG:
                v = b + x
                if v > best2[5]:
                    best2[5] = v
                v = b + y
                if v > best2[6]:
                    best2[6] = v
                v = b + z
                if v > best2[0]:
                    best2[0] = v

            if x > best1[0]:
                best1[0] = x
            if y > best1[1]:
                best1[1] = y
            if z > best1[2]:
                best1[2] = z

        min_loss = INF

        # Use no outside cake.
        if dp[0] < min_loss:
            min_loss = dp[0]

        # Use one outside cake.
        if max_u >= 1:
            l = dp[8 + 1]
            b = best1[0]
            if l != INF and b != NEG:
                loss = l - b
                if loss < min_loss:
                    min_loss = loss

            l = dp[8 + 2]
            b = best1[1]
            if l != INF and b != NEG:
                loss = l - b
                if loss < min_loss:
                    min_loss = loss

            l = dp[8 + 4]
            b = best1[2]
            if l != INF and b != NEG:
                loss = l - b
                if loss < min_loss:
                    min_loss = loss

        # Use two outside cakes.
        if max_u >= 2:
            base = 16
            for mask in range(8):
                b = best2[mask]
                if b == NEG:
                    continue
                l = dp[base + mask]
                if l == INF:
                    continue
                loss = l - b
                if loss < min_loss:
                    min_loss = loss

        out.append(str(sum_m - min_loss))

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return

    n = int(data[0])
    if n <= 1:
        print(-1)
        return

    idx = 1
    x_prev = int(data[idx])
    h_prev = int(data[idx + 1])
    idx += 2

    found = False
    best_num = 0
    best_den = 1

    for _ in range(n - 1):
        x = int(data[idx])
        h = int(data[idx + 1])
        idx += 2

        # y-intercept of the line through the tops of adjacent buildings:
        # (x * h_prev - x_prev * h) / (x - x_prev)
        num = x * h_prev - x_prev * h
        den = x - x_prev

        if num >= 0:
            if not found or num * best_den > best_num * den:
                found = True
                best_num = num
                best_den = den

        x_prev, h_prev = x, h

    if not found:
        print(-1)
    else:
        ans = best_num / best_den
        print(f"{ans:.18f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    if n <= 1:
        print(-1)
        return
    idx = 1
    x_prev = int(data[idx]); h_prev = int(data[idx+1]); idx += 2
    found = False
    best_num = 0
    best_den = 1
    for _ in range(n-1):
        x = int(data[idx]); h = int(data[idx+1]); idx += 2
        num = x * h_prev - x_prev * h
        den = x - x_prev
        if num >= 0:
            if not found or num * best_den > best_num * den:
                found = True
                best_num = num
                best_den = den
        x_prev, h_prev = x, h
    if not found:
        print(-1)
    else:
        ans = best_num / best_den
        print(f"{ans:.15f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

MOD = 998244353
ROOT = 3


def count_small(S, maxS):
    S.sort()
    present = bytearray(maxS + 1)
    for x in S:
        present[x] = 1

    n = len(S)
    ans = 0
    arr = S
    p = present
    m = maxS

    for j in range(n):
        b = arr[j]
        twob = b << 1
        if j < n - j:
            for i in range(j - 1, -1, -1):
                c = twob - arr[i]
                if c > m:
                    break
                if p[c]:
                    ans += 1
        else:
            for k in range(j + 1, n):
                a = twob - arr[k]
                if a < 1:
                    break
                if p[a]:
                    ans += 1
    return ans


def count_numpy(S, maxS, np):
    mod = MOD
    n = 1 << (2 * maxS).bit_length()

    a = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int64)
    a[S] = 1

    omega = pow(ROOT, (mod - 1) // n, mod)
    iomega = pow(omega, mod - 2, mod)

    def make_roots(w, length):
        roots = np.empty(length, dtype=np.int64)
        roots[0] = 1
        size = 1
        factor = w
        while size < length:
            roots[size:2 * size] = (roots[:size] * factor) % mod
            factor = (factor * factor) % mod
            size <<= 1
        return roots

    roots = make_roots(omega, n // 2)
    iroots = make_roots(iomega, n // 2)

    length = n
    while length > 1:
        half = length >> 1
        step = n // length
        w = roots[::step]
        if step != 1:
            w = w.copy()

        ar = a.reshape(-1, length)
        left = ar[:, :half]
        right = ar[:, half:]

        t = left + right
        np.subtract(t, mod, out=t, where=t >= mod)

        u = left - right
        np.add(u, mod, out=u, where=u < 0)

        u *= w
        np.remainder(u, mod, out=u)

        ar[:, :half] = t
        ar[:, half:] = u

        length = half

    a *= a
    np.remainder(a, mod, out=a)

    length = 2
    while length <= n:
        half = length >> 1
        step = n // length
        w = iroots[::step]
        if step != 1:
            w = w.copy()

        ar = a.reshape(-1, length)
        left = ar[:, :half]
        right = ar[:, half:]

        rw = right * w
        np.remainder(rw, mod, out=rw)

        t = left + rw
        np.subtract(t, mod, out=t, where=t >= mod)

        ar[:, half:] = u

        length <<= 1

    inv_n = pow(n, mod - 2, mod)
    vals = (a[idx] * inv_n) % mod

```
def butterfly(self, a):
    n = len(a)
    h = (n - 1).bit_length() - 1
    mod = self.mod
    rate2 = self.rate2
    rate3 = self.rate3
    root = self.root
    len_ = 0
    while len_ < h:
        if h - len_ == 1:
            p = 1 << (h - len_ - 1)
            rot = 1
            for s in range(1 << len_):
                offset = s << (h - len_)
                for i in range(p):
                    l = a[i + offset]
                    r = a[i + offset + p] * rot % mod
                    a[i + offset] = (l + r) % mod
                    a[i + offset + p] = (l - r) % mod
                if s + 1 != (1 << len_):
                    rot = rot * rate2[len_] % mod
            len_ += 1
        else:
            p = 1 << (h - len_ - 2)
            rot = 1
            imag = root[2]
            for s in range(1 << len_):
                rot2 = rot * rot % mod
                rot3 = rot2 * rot % mod
                offset = s << (h - len_)
                for i in range(p):
                    a0 = a[i + offset]
                    a1 = a[i + offset + p] * rot % mod
                    a2 = a[i + offset + 2*p] * rot2 % mod
                    a3 = a[i + offset + 3*p] * rot3 % mod
                    a1na3imag = (a1 - a3) % mod * imag % mod
                    na2 = mod - a2
                    a[i + offset] = (a0 + a2 + a1 + a3) % mod
                    a[i + offset + p] = (a0 + a2 - a1 - a3) % mod
                    a[i + offset + 2*p] = (a0 + na2 + a1na3imag) % mod
                    a[i + offset + 3*p] = (a0 + na2 - a1na3imag) % mod
                if s + 1 != (1 << len_):
                    rot = rot * rate3[len_] % mod
            len_ += 2
```

def butterfly_inv(self, a):
    n=len(a); h=(n-1).bit_length()-1
    mod=self.mod; irate2=self.irate2; irate3=self.irate3; iroot=self.iroot
    len_ = h
    while len_:
        if len_ == 1:
            p = 1 << (h - len_)
            irot = 1
            for s in range(1 << (len_ - 1)):
                offset = s << (h - len_ + 1)
                for i in range(p):
                    l = a[i + offset]
                    r = a[i + offset + p]
                    a[i + offset] = (l + r) % mod
                    a[i + offset + p] = (l - r) * irot % mod
                if s + 1 != (1 << (len_ - 1)):
                    irot = irot * irate2[len_ - 1] % mod
            len_ -= 1
        else:
            p = 1 << (h - len_)
            irot = 1
            iimag = iroot[2]
            for s in range(1 << (len_ - 2)):
                irot2 = irot * irot % mod
                irot3 = irot2 * irot % mod
                offset = s << (h - len_ + 2)
                for i in range(p):
                    a0 = a[i + offset]
                    a1 = a[i + offset + p]
                    a2 = a[i + offset + 2*p]
                    a3 = a[i + offset + 3*p]
                    a2na3iimag = (a2 - a3) * iimag % mod
                    a[i + offset] = (a0 + a1 + a2 + a3) % mod

                if s + 1 != (1 << (len_ - 2)):
                    irot = irot * irate3[len_ - 2] % mod
            len_ -= 2
    inv_n = pow(n, mod-2, mod)
    for i in range(n): a[i] = a[i] * inv_n % mod

def count_small(S, maxS):
    S.sort()
    present = bytearray(maxS + 1)
    for x in S:
        present[x] = 1

    n = len(S)
    ans = 0
    arr = S
    p = present
    m = maxS

    for j in range(n):
        b = arr[j]
        twob = b << 1
        if j < n - j:
            # Iterate on the smaller left side.  Values are increasing, so
            # going backwards makes the needed right endpoint increase.
            for i in range(j - 1, -1, -1):
                c = twob - arr[i]
                if c > m:
                    break
                if p[c]:
                    ans += 1
        else:
            # Iterate on the smaller right side.  Going forwards makes the
            # needed left endpoint decrease.
            for k in range(j + 1, n):
                a = twob - arr[k]
                if a < 1:
                    break
                if p[a]:
                    ans += 1
    return ans

    n = 1 << (2 * maxS).bit_length()

    a = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int64)

    iomega = pow(omega, mod - 2, mod)

        roots[0] = 1
        size = 1
        factor = w
        while size < length:

            factor = (factor * factor) % mod
            size <<= 1

    iroots = make_roots(iomega, n // 2)

    # Forward NTT (decimation in frequency), output is bit-reversed.
    length = n
    while length > 1:

        step = n // length
        w = roots[::step]

            w = w.copy()

        ar = a.reshape(-1, length)
        left = ar[:, :half]
        right = ar[:, half:]

        t = left + right
        np.subtract(t, mod, out=t, where=t >= mod)

import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data: return
    N = data[0]
    X = data[1:1+N]
    gaps = [X[i+1]-X[i] for i in range(N-1)]
    odd = gaps[0::2]
    even = gaps[1::2]
    odd.sort()
    even.sort()
    ans = N * X[0]
    oi = ei = 0
    # local variables for speed
    for k in range(N-1):
        if k & 1:
            g = even[ei]; ei += 1
        else:
            g = odd[oi]; oi += 1
        ans += g * (N - 1 - k)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from typing import List

class Solution:
    def longestSpecialPath(self, edges: List[List[int]], nums: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        if n == 0:
            return [0, 0]

        adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for u, v, w in edges:
            adj[u].append((v, w))
            adj[v].append((u, w))

        # last[value] = deepest depth on the current root-to-node path
        # where this value occurs, or -1 if it is not currently on the path.
        last = {}

        # dist_at_depth[d] = distance from root to the node at depth d
        # on the current root-to-node path.
        dist_at_depth = [0] * n

        best_len = 0
        best_nodes = 1

        # Enter event: (node, parent, depth, distance_from_root, start_depth)
        # Exit event:  (-node - 1, value, old_last_depth)
        stack = [(0, -1, 0, 0, 0)]

        while stack:
            item = stack.pop()

            # Exit event: restore the previous last occurrence.
            if item[0] < 0:
                last[item[1]] = item[2]
                continue

            u, parent, depth, dist, start = item
            val = nums[u]

            old = last.get(val, -1)

            # If the value already appears in the current unique window,
            # move the window start just after its previous occurrence.
            new_start = start if old < start else old + 1

            last[val] = depth
            dist_at_depth[depth] = dist

            # Longest special path ending at u starts at depth new_start.
            length = dist - dist_at_depth[new_start]
            nodes = depth - new_start + 1

            if length > best_len:
                best_len = length
                best_nodes = nodes
            elif length == best_len and nodes < best_nodes:
                best_nodes = nodes

            # Push exit event, then child enter events.
            stack.append((-u - 1, val, old))

            next_depth = depth + 1
            for v, w in adj[u]:
                if v != parent:
                    stack.append((v, u, next_depth, dist + w, new_start))

        return [best_len, best_nodes]

from typing import List

class Solution:
    def longestSpecialPath(self, edges: List[List[int]], nums: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for u, v, w in edges:
            adj[u].append((v, w))
            adj[v].append((u, w))

        max_val = max(nums)
        last = [-1] * (max_val + 1)
        dist_at_depth = [0] * n

        best_len = 0
        best_nodes = 1

        # (node, parent, depth, distance_from_root, start_depth, state, old_last, value)
        stack = [(0, -1, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1, 0)]
        while stack:
            u, parent, depth, dist, start, state, old, val = stack.pop()
            if state == 0:
                val = nums[u]
                old = last[val]
                new_start = start
                if old >= start:
                    new_start = old + 1

                last[val] = depth
                dist_at_depth[depth] = dist

                length = dist - dist_at_depth[new_start]
                nodes = depth - new_start + 1
                if length > best_len:
                    best_len = length
                    best_nodes = nodes
                elif length == best_len and nodes < best_nodes:
                    best_nodes = nodes

                stack.append((u, parent, depth, dist, start, 1, old, val))
                next_depth = depth + 1
                for v, w in adj[u]:
                    if v != parent:
                        stack.append((v, u, next_depth, dist + w, new_start, 0, -1, 0))
            else:
                last[val] = old

        return [best_len, best_nodes]

from typing import List

class Solution:
    def longestSpecialPath(self, edges: List[List[int]], nums: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        if n == 0:
            return [0, 0]
        adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for u, v, w in edges:
            adj[u].append((v, w))
            adj[v].append((u, w))
        last = [-1] * (max(nums) + 1)
        dist_at_depth = [0] * n
        best_len = 0
        best_nodes = 1
        stack = [(0, -1, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1, 0)]
        while stack:
            u, parent, depth, dist, start, state, old, val = stack.pop()
            if state == 0:
                val = nums[u]
                old = last[val]
                new_start = start if old < start else old + 1
                last[val] = depth
                dist_at_depth[depth] = dist
                length = dist - dist_at_depth[new_start]
                nodes = depth - new_start + 1
                if length > best_len:
                    best_len = length
                    best_nodes = nodes
                elif length == best_len and nodes < best_nodes:
                    best_nodes = nodes
                stack.append((u, parent, depth, dist, start, 1, old, val))
                nd = depth + 1
                for v, w in adj[u]:
                    if v != parent:
                        stack.append((v, u, nd, dist + w, new_start, 0, -1, 0))
            else:
                last[val] = old
        return [best_len, best_nodes]
```

from typing import List

class Solution:
    def longestSpecialPath(self, edges: List[List[int]], nums: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        if n == 0:
            return [0, 0]
        adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for u, v, w in edges:
            adj[u].append((v, w))
            adj[v].append((u, w))
        last = {}
        dist_at_depth = [0] * n
        best_len = 0
        best_nodes = 1
        stack = [(0, -1, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1, 0)]
        while stack:
            u, parent, depth, dist, start, state, old, val = stack.pop()
            if state == 0:
                val = nums[u]
                old = last.get(val, -1)
                new_start = start if old < start else old + 1
                last[val] = depth
                dist_at_depth[depth] = dist
                length = dist - dist_at_depth[new_start]
                nodes = depth - new_start + 1
                if length > best_len:
                    best_len = length
                    best_nodes = nodes
                elif length == best_len and nodes < best_nodes:
                    best_nodes = nodes
                stack.append((u, parent, depth, dist, start, 1, old, val))
                nd = depth + 1
                for v, w in adj[u]:
                    if v != parent:
                        stack.append((v, u, nd, dist + w, new_start, 0, -1, 0))
            else:
                last[val] = old
        return [best_len, best_nodes]
```

from typing import List

class Solution:
    def longestSpecialPath(self, edges: List[List[int]], nums: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        if n == 0:
            return [0, 0]
        adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for u, v, w in edges:
            adj[u].append((v, w))
            adj[v].append((u, w))

        last = {}
        dist_at_depth = [0] * n
        best_len = 0
        best_nodes = 1

        stack = [(0, -1, 0, 0, 0)]
        while stack:
            item = stack.pop()
            if item[0] < 0:
                last[item[1]] = item[2]
                continue

            u, parent, depth, dist, start = item
            val = nums[u]
            old = last.get(val, -1)
            new_start = start if old < start else old + 1

            last[val] = depth
            dist_at_depth[depth] = dist

            length = dist - dist_at_depth[new_start]
            nodes = depth - new_start + 1
            if length > best_len:
                best_len = length
                best_nodes = nodes
            elif length == best_len and nodes < best_nodes:
                best_nodes = nodes

            stack.append((-u - 1, val, old))
            next_depth = depth + 1
            for v, w in adj[u]:
                if v != parent:
                    stack.append((v, u, next_depth, dist + w, new_start))

        return [best_len, best_nodes]

import sys

MOD = 998244353


def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return

    it = iter(data)
    nxt = it.__next__
    T = int(nxt())

    ans = []
    append = ans.append

    for _ in range(T):
        H = int(nxt())
        W = int(nxt())

        n = H + W
        parent = list(range(n))
        size = [1] * n
        diff = [0] * n  # xor to parent
        comp = n

        def find(x, parent=parent, diff=diff):
            xr = 0
            while parent[x] != x:
                xr ^= diff[x]
                p = parent[x]
                gp = parent[p]
                if gp != p:
                    diff[x] ^= diff[p]
                    parent[x] = gp
                x = p
            return x, xr

        # col_pref[j] = parity of A's in column j among already processed rows
        col_pref = [0] * W
        dead = False
        base = H

        for i in range(H):
            s = nxt()
            if dead:
                continue

            row_pref = 0  # parity of A's in current row up to current column

            for j, ch in enumerate(s):
                if ch == 65:  # 'A'
                    row_pref ^= 1
                    col_pref[j] ^= 1
                else:  # 'B'
                    # Equation: row_i xor col_j = 1 xor Pv(i,j) xor Ph(i,j)
                    w = 1 ^ col_pref[j] ^ row_pref

                    rx, px = find(i)
                    ry, py = find(base + j)

                    if rx == ry:
                        if (px ^ py) != w:
                            dead = True
                            break
                    else:
                        if size[rx] < size[ry]:
                            parent[rx] = ry
                            diff[rx] = px ^ py ^ w
                            size[ry] += size[rx]
                        else:
                            parent[ry] = rx
                            diff[ry] = px ^ py ^ w
                            size[rx] += size[ry]
                        comp -= 1

            if dead:
                continue

            # Each row must contain an even number of A tiles.
            if row_pref != 0:
                dead = True

        if dead:
            append("0")
            continue

        # Each column must contain an even number of A tiles.
        if any(col_pref):
            append("0")
            continue

        append(str(pow(2, comp, MOD)))

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(ans))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

def solve():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data: return
    it = iter(data)
    T = int(next(it))
    MOD = 998244353
    out = []
    for _ in range(T):
        H = int(next(it)); W = int(next(it))
        n = H + W
        parent = list(range(n))
        size = [1] * n
        diff = bytearray(n)
        comp = n
        def find(x):
            xr = 0
            while parent[x] != x:
                xr ^= diff[x]
                p = parent[x]
                gp = parent[p]
                if gp != p:
                    diff[x] ^= diff[p]
                    parent[x] = gp
                x = p
            return x, xr
        col_pref = bytearray(W)
        dead = False
        for i in range(H):
            s = next(it)
            if dead:
                continue
            row_pref = 0
            # maybe local variables for speed
            # But find uses parent/diff; inline union uses size, comp.
            for j, ch in enumerate(s):
                if ch == 65:  # A
                    row_pref ^= 1
                    col_pref[j] ^= 1
                else:
                    w = 1 ^ col_pref[j] ^ row_pref
                    x = i
                    y = H + j
                    rx, px = find(x)
                    ry, py = find(y)
                    if rx == ry:
                        if (px ^ py) != w:
                            dead = True
                            break
                    else:
                        if size[rx] < size[ry]:
                            parent[rx] = ry
                            diff[rx] = px ^ py ^ w
                            size[ry] += size[rx]
                        else:
                            parent[ry] = rx
                            diff[ry] = px ^ py ^ w
                            size[rx] += size[ry]
                        comp -= 1
            if dead:
                continue
            if row_pref != 0:
                dead = True
        if dead:
            out.append('0')
            continue
        if any(col_pref):
            out.append('0')
            continue
        out.append(str(pow(2, comp, MOD)))
    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(out))

import sys

MOD = 998244353

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    nxt = it.__next__
    T = int(nxt())
    ans = []
    for _ in range(T):
        H = int(nxt()); W = int(nxt())
        n = H + W
        parent = list(range(n))
        size = [1] * n
        diff = [0] * n
        comp = n

        def find(x, parent=parent, diff=diff):
            xr = 0
            while parent[x] != x:
                xr ^= diff[x]
                p = parent[x]
                gp = parent[p]
                if gp != p:
                    diff[x] ^= diff[p]
                    parent[x] = gp
                x = p
            return x, xr

        col_pref = [0] * W
        dead = False
        base = H
        for i in range(H):
            s = nxt()
            if dead:
                continue
            row_pref = 0
            for j, ch in enumerate(s):
                if ch == 65:  # 'A'
                    row_pref ^= 1
                    col_pref[j] ^= 1
                else:
                    w = 1 ^ col_pref[j] ^ row_pref
                    rx, px = find(i)
                    ry, py = find(base + j)
                    if rx == ry:
                        if (px ^ py) != w:
                            dead = True
                            break
                    else:
                        if size[rx] < size[ry]:
                            parent[rx] = ry
                            diff[rx] = px ^ py ^ w
                            size[ry] += size[rx]
                        else:
                            parent[ry] = rx
                            diff[ry] = px ^ py ^ w
                            size[rx] += size[ry]
                        comp -= 1
            if dead:
                continue
            if row_pref != 0:
                dead = True
        if dead:
            ans.append("0")
            continue
        if any(col_pref):
            ans.append("0")
            continue
        ans.append(str(pow(2, comp, MOD)))
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
```

                xr ^= diff[x]
                p = parent[x]
                gp = parent[p]
                if gp != p:
                    diff[x] ^= diff[p]
                    parent[x] = gp

def solve():
    import sys
    MOD=998244353
    N=int(sys.stdin.buffer.readline())
    L=len(str(N))
    pow10=[1]*(L+1)
    for i in range(1,L+1): pow10[i]=pow10[i-1]*10
    q=[0]*(L+1)
    for i in range(1,L+1): q[i]=pow10[i]%MOD
    cnt=[0]*(L+1)
    sm=[0]*(L+1)
    for d in range(1,L+1):
        a=pow10[d-1]
        b=min(N,pow10[d]-1)
        if a<=b:
            c=b-a+1
            cnt[d]=c
            sm[d]=((a+b)*c//2)%MOD
    fact=[1]*(N+1)
    for i in range(1,N+1): fact[i]=fact[i-1]*i%MOD
    inv=[0]*(N+1)
    if N>=1:
        inv[1]=1
        for i in range(2,N+1):
            inv[i]=MOD - (MOD//i)*inv[MOD%i]%MOD
    p=[1]
    for d in range(1,L+1):
        qd=q[d]
        p.append(0)
        for j in range(len(p)-1,0,-1):
            p[j]=(p[j]+p[j-1]*qd)%MOD
    r=[0]*L
    for d in range(1,L+1):
        if cnt[d]==0: continue
        qd=q[d]
        h=[0]*L
        h[0]=1
        for j in range(1,L):
            h[j]=(p[j]-qd*h[j-1])%MOD
        coeff=cnt[d]%MOD*qd%MOD
        for j in range(L):
            r[j]=(r[j]+coeff*h[j])%MOD
    f=[0]*(N+1)
    f[0]=1
    for n in range(N):
        rhs=0
        maxj=L-1
        if maxj>n: maxj=n
        for j in range(maxj+1):
            rhs=(rhs+r[j]*f[n-j])%MOD
        lhs=0
        maxj=L
        if maxj>n: maxj=n
        for j in range(1,maxj+1):
            lhs=(lhs+p[j]*(n-j+1)*f[n-j+1])%MOD
        f[n+1]=(rhs-lhs)%MOD*inv[n+1]%MOD
    weight=[0]*N
    for m in range(N):
        weight[m]=fact[N-1-m]*fact[m]%MOD
    ans=0
    for a in range(1,L+1):
        if cnt[a]==0: continue
        qd=q[a]
        g_prev=0
        total=0
        for m in range(N):
            g=(f[m]-qd*g_prev)%MOD
            total=(total+g*weight[m])%MOD
            g_prev=g
        ans=(ans+sm[a]*total)%MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__=='__main__': solve()

import sys

MOD = 998244353

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    N = int(data[0])

    L = len(str(N))
    pow10 = [1] * (L + 1)
    for i in range(1, L + 1):
        pow10[i] = pow10[i - 1] * 10

    q = [0] * (L + 1)
    for i in range(1, L + 1):
        q[i] = pow10[i] % MOD

    cnt = [0] * (L + 1)
    sm = [0] * (L + 1)
    for d in range(1, L + 1):
        start = pow10[d - 1]
        end = min(N, pow10[d] - 1)
        if start <= end:
            c = end - start + 1
            cnt[d] = c
            sm[d] = ((start + end) * c // 2) % MOD

    fact = [1] * (N + 1)
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD

    inv = [0] * (N + 1)
    if N >= 1:
        inv[1] = 1
        for i in range(2, N + 1):
            inv[i] = MOD - (MOD // i) * inv[MOD % i] % MOD

    p = [1]
    for d in range(1, L + 1):
        qd = q[d]
        p.append(0)
        for j in range(len(p) - 1, 0, -1):
            p[j] = (p[j] + p[j - 1] * qd) % MOD

    r = [0] * L
    for d in range(1, L + 1):
        if cnt[d] == 0:
            continue
        qd = q[d]
        h = [0] * L
        h[0] = 1
        for j in range(1, L):
            h[j] = (p[j] - qd * h[j - 1]) % MOD
        coeff = (cnt[d] % MOD) * qd % MOD
        for j in range(L):
            r[j] = (r[j] + coeff * h[j]) % MOD

    f = [0] * (N + 1)
    f[0] = 1
    p_list = p
    r_list = r
    inv_list = inv
    f_list = f
    mod = MOD
    L_val = L
    for n in range(N):
        rhs = 0
        maxj = L_val - 1
        if maxj > n:
            maxj = n
        for j in range(maxj + 1):
            rhs += r_list[j] * f_list[n - j]

        lhs = 0
        maxj = L_val
        if maxj > n:
            maxj = n
        for j in range(1, maxj + 1):
            lhs += p_list[j] * (n - j + 1) * f_list[n - j + 1]

        f_list[n + 1] = ((rhs - lhs) % mod) * inv_list[n + 1] % mod

    weight = [0] * N
    for m in range(N):
        weight[m] = fact[N - 1 - m] * fact[m] % mod

    ans = 0
    weight_list = weight
    for d in range(1, L + 1):
        if cnt[d] == 0 or sm[d] == 0:
            continue
        qd = q[d]
        g_prev = 0
        total = 0
        for m in range(N):
            g = (f_list[m] - qd * g_prev) % mod
            total += g * weight_list[m]
            g_prev = g
        ans = (ans + sm[d] * (total % mod)) % mod

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from typing import List

class Solution:
    def countComponents(self, nums: List[int], threshold: int) -> int:
        T = threshold
        parent = list(range(T+1))
        size = [1]*(T+1)
        first = [0]*(T+1)
        present = bytearray(T+1)
        present_vals = []
        isolated = 0
        for x in nums:
            if x <= T:
                if not present[x]:
                    present[x]=1
                    present_vals.append(x)
            else:
                isolated += 1
        if not present_vals:
            return isolated
        # optional if 1 present: return isolated + 1
        if present[1]:
            return isolated + 1
        def find(x):
            while parent[x] != x:
                parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
                x = parent[x]
            return x
        def union(a,b):
            ra = find(a); rb = find(b)
            if ra == rb: return
            if size[ra] < size[rb]: ra,rb = rb,ra
            parent[rb] = ra
            size[ra] += size[rb]
        # maybe sort present_vals? If 1 absent. Sorting ascending may set first to smaller divisors. Not required. But sorting could improve union tree? union by size. It also ensures when d present, all smaller divisors processed. But if not sorted, still correct. Sorting O(m log m). Could skip.
        # However, if we don't sort, and present_vals has large d first, first[m] may be large, then small d union. Fine.
        for d in present_vals:
            # local variables for speed?
            for m in range(d, T+1, d):
                f = first[m]
                if f:
                    union(d, f)
                else:
                    first[m] = d
        roots = set()
        for x in present_vals:
            roots.add(find(x))
        return isolated + len(roots)

from typing import List

class Solution:
    def countComponents(self, nums: List[int], threshold: int) -> int:
        T = threshold
        present = bytearray(T + 1)
        present_vals = []
        isolated = 0

        for x in nums:
            if x <= T:
                if not present[x]:
                    present[x] = 1
                    present_vals.append(x)
            else:
                isolated += 1

        if not present_vals:
            return isolated
        if len(present_vals) == 1:
            return isolated + 1
        if present[1]:
            return isolated + 1

        parent = list(range(T + 1))
        size = [1] * (T + 1)
        first = [0] * (T + 1)

        def find(x: int) -> int:
            while parent[x] != x:
                parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
                x = parent[x]
            return x

        def union(a: int, b: int) -> None:
            ra = find(a)
            rb = find(b)
            if ra == rb:
                return
            if size[ra] < size[rb]:
                ra, rb = rb, ra
            parent[rb] = ra
            size[ra] += size[rb]

        T1 = T + 1
        for d in present_vals:
            for m in range(d, T1, d):
                f = first[m]
                if f == 0:
                    first[m] = d
                elif f != d:
                    union(d, f)

        roots = set()
        for x in present_vals:
            roots.add(find(x))
        return isolated + len(roots)

from collections import deque

class Solution:
    def minLength(self, s: str, numOps: int) -> int:
        n = len(s)
        if n <= 1:
            return 1
        
        pref0 = [0] * (n + 1)
        pref1 = [0] * (n + 1)
        max_run = 1
        cur = 1
        for i, ch in enumerate(s, 1):
            pref0[i] = pref0[i - 1] + (1 if ch == '1' else 0)
            pref1[i] = pref1[i - 1] + (1 if ch == '0' else 0)
            if i > 1:
                if s[i - 1] == s[i - 2]:
                    cur += 1
                else:
                    if cur > max_run:
                        max_run = cur
                    cur = 1
        if cur > max_run:
            max_run = cur
        
        if max_run == 1 or numOps == 0:
            return max_run
        
        INF = 10 ** 9
        
        def can(k: int) -> bool:
            if k >= max_run:  # original string already valid? Actually if k>=max_run true. But high=max_run, mid<max_run maybe. Could use k>=n.
                return True
            # deques store (index, value)
            dq0 = deque([(0, 0)])  # value = dp1[j] - pref0[j]
            dq1 = deque([(0, 0)])  # value = dp0[j] - pref1[j]
            dp0 = dp1 = 0
            for i in range(1, n + 1):
                limit = i - k
                while dq0 and dq0[0][0] < limit:
                    dq0.popleft()
                while dq1 and dq1[0][0] < limit:
                    dq1.popleft()
                dp0 = pref0[i] + dq0[0][1] if dq0 else INF
                dp1 = pref1[i] + dq1[0][1] if dq1 else INF
                if dp0 > INF:
                    dp0 = INF
                if dp1 > INF:
                    dp1 = INF
                
                val0 = dp1 - pref0[i]
                while dq0 and dq0[-1][1] >= val0:
                    dq0.pop()
                dq0.append((i, val0))
                
                val1 = dp0 - pref1[i]
                while dq1 and dq1[-1][1] >= val1:
                    dq1.pop()
                dq1.append((i, val1))
            return min(dp0, dp1) <= numOps
        
        lo, hi = 1, max_run
        while lo < hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            if can(mid):
                hi = mid
            else:
                lo = mid + 1
        return lo
```

from collections import deque

class Solution:
    def minLength(self, s: str, numOps: int) -> int:
        n = len(s)
        if n == 1:
            return 1

        pref0 = [0] * (n + 1)
        pref1 = [0] * (n + 1)
        max_run = 1
        cur = 1
        for i in range(n):
            ch = s[i]
            pref0[i + 1] = pref0[i] + (1 if ch == '1' else 0)
            pref1[i + 1] = pref1[i] + (1 if ch == '0' else 0)
            if i > 0:
                if s[i] == s[i - 1]:
                    cur += 1
                else:
                    if cur > max_run:
                        max_run = cur
                    cur = 1
        if cur > max_run:
            max_run = cur

        if max_run == 1 or numOps == 0:
            return max_run

        INF = 10 ** 9

        def can(k: int) -> bool:
            if k >= max_run:
                return True
            dq0 = deque([(0, 0)])
            dq1 = deque([(0, 0)])
            dp0 = dp1 = 0
            for i in range(1, n + 1):
                limit = i - k
                while dq0 and dq0[0][0] < limit:
                    dq0.popleft()
                while dq1 and dq1[0][0] < limit:
                    dq1.popleft()

                dp0 = pref0[i] + dq0[0][1] if dq0 else INF
                dp1 = pref1[i] + dq1[0][1] if dq1 else INF
                if dp0 > INF:
                    dp0 = INF
                if dp1 > INF:
                    dp1 = INF

                val0 = dp1 - pref0[i]
                while dq0 and dq0[-1][1] >= val0:

import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return

    n = int(data[0])
    s = data[1]
    t = data[2]

    # Required mapping for each letter appearing in S.
    # If one letter must become two different letters, impossible.
    f = [-1] * 26
    mask_s = 0
    mask_t = 0

    for cs, ct in zip(s, t):
        a = ord(cs) - 97
        b = ord(ct) - 97
        mask_s |= 1 << a
        mask_t |= 1 << b

        if f[a] == -1:
            f[a] = b
        elif f[a] != b:
            print(-1)
            return

    # Build the directed graph of required non-self replacements.
    out = [-1] * 26
    indeg = [0] * 26
    edges = 0

    for i in range(26):
        if f[i] != -1 and f[i] != i:
            j = f[i]
            out[i] = j
            indeg[j] += 1
            edges += 1

    # Count cycles that have no incoming edge from outside the cycle.
    # Each such "source cycle" needs one extra operation if it is solvable.
    state = [0] * 26  # 0: unvisited, 1: visiting, 2: done
    source_cycles = 0

    for i in range(26):
        if state[i] != 0:
            continue

        v = i
        stack = []
        pos = [-1] * 26

        while v != -1 and state[v] == 0:
            state[v] = 1
            pos[v] = len(stack)
            stack.append(v)
            v = out[v]

        if v != -1 and state[v] == 1:
            start = pos[v]
            is_source_cycle = True
            for node in stack[start:]:
                if indeg[node] != 1:
                    is_source_cycle = False
                    break
            if is_source_cycle:
                source_cycles += 1

        for node in stack:
            state[node] = 2

    full = (1 << 26) - 1

    # If every letter is initially present and every letter is finally needed,
    # the required mapping is a permutation. A non-trivial permutation cycle
    # cannot be resolved without an empty temporary letter.
    if source_cycles > 0 and mask_s == full and mask_t == full:
        print(-1)
    else:
        print(edges + source_cycles)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

import sys
from collections import deque

def solve():
    data=sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data: return
    N=int(data[0]); S=data[1].strip(); T=data[2].strip()
    f=[-1]*26
    for cs,ct in zip(S,T):
        a=ord(cs)-97; b=ord(ct)-97
        if f[a]==-1: f[a]=b
        elif f[a]!=b:
            print(-1); return
    out=[-1]*26
    indeg=[0]*26
    edges=0
    for i in range(26):
        if f[i]!=-1 and f[i]!=i:
            j=f[i]
            out[i]=j
            indeg[j]+=1
            edges+=1
    # Kahn
    indeg_work=indeg[:]
    q=deque([i for i in range(26) if indeg_work[i]==0])
    removed=[False]*26
    while q:
        v=q.popleft()
        removed[v]=True
        u=out[v]
        if u!=-1:
            indeg_work[u]-=1
            if indeg_work[u]==0:
                q.append(u)
    visited=[False]*26
    source_cycles=0
    for i in range(26):
        if not removed[i] and not visited[i]:
            v=i
            is_source=True
            while not visited[v]:
                visited[v]=True
                if indeg[v] != 1:
                    is_source=False
                v=out[v]
            if is_source:
                source_cycles+=1
    if source_cycles>0 and len(set(S))==26 and len(set(T))==26:
        print(-1)

class Solution:
    def minCostGoodCaption(self, caption: str) -> str:
        n = len(caption)
        if n < 3:
            return ""

        A = 26
        STATES = A * 3
        INF = 10**9
        INF_KEY = 10**9

        rangeA = range(A)
        rangeS = range(STATES)

        cost_table = [[abs(i - j) for j in rangeA] for i in rangeA]
        arr = [ord(ch) - 97 for ch in caption]

        # state id = char * 3 + (run_length - 1), run_length capped at 3
        s1 = [c * 3 for c in rangeA]
        s2 = [c * 3 + 1 for c in rangeA]
        s3 = [c * 3 + 2 for c in rangeA]
        chars = [chr(97 + c) for c in rangeA]

        dp = [INF] * STATES
        rank = [0] * STATES

        row = cost_table[arr[0]]
        for c in rangeA:
            dp[s1[c]] = row[c]
            rank[s1[c]] = c

        # parents[pos * STATES + state] = previous state for transition at pos
        parents = bytearray(b'\xff') * (n * STATES)

        for i in range(1, n):
            row = cost_table[arr[i]]

            # Best two states with run length >= 3, ordered by (cost, lex rank)
            b1v = INF
            b1r = INF
            b1s = -1
            b1c = -1
            b2v = INF
            b2r = INF
            b2s = -1
            b2c = -1

            for c in rangeA:
                sid = s3[c]
                v = dp[sid]
                if v < INF:
                    r = rank[sid]
                    if v < b1v or (v == b1v and r < b1r):
                        b2v, b2r, b2s, b2c = b1v, b1r, b1s, b1c
                        b1v, b1r, b1s, b1c = v, r, sid, c
                    elif v < b2v or (v == b2v and r < b2r):
                        b2v, b2r, b2s, b2c = v, r, sid, c

            ndp = [INF] * STATES
            nkey = [0] * STATES
            base = i * STATES

            # Continue the current run.
            for c in rangeA:
                cost = row[c]

                # length 1 -> length 2
                sid1 = s1[c]
                v = dp[sid1]
                if v < INF:
                    nsid = s2[c]
                    ndp[nsid] = v + cost
                    nkey[nsid] = rank[sid1] * A + c
                    parents[base + nsid] = sid1

                # length 2 -> length 3, and length 3 -> length 3
                sid2 = s2[c]
                sid3 = s3[c]

                v2 = dp[sid2]
                if v2 < INF:
                    cand2 = v2 + cost
                    key2 = rank[sid2] * A + c
                    ps2 = sid2
                else:
                    cand2 = INF
                    key2 = INF_KEY
                    ps2 = -1

                v3 = dp[sid3]
                if v3 < INF:
                    cand3 = v3 + cost
                    key3 = rank[sid3] * A + c
                    ps3 = sid3
                else:
                    cand3 = INF
                    key3 = INF_KEY
                    ps3 = -1

                if cand2 < cand3 or (cand2 == cand3 and key2 < key3):
                    if cand2 < INF:
                        ndp[sid3] = cand2
                        nkey[sid3] = key2
                        parents[base + sid3] = ps2
                else:
                    if cand3 < INF:
                        ndp[sid3] = cand3
                        nkey[sid3] = key3
                        parents[base + sid3] = ps3

            # Start a new run after a completed run of length at least 3.
            if b1s != -1:
                for y in rangeA:
                    if b1c != y:
                        v = b1v
                        r = b1r
                        ps = b1s
                    elif b2s != -1 and b2c != y:
                        v = b2v
                        r = b2r
                        ps = b2s
                    else:
                        continue

                    nsid = s1[y]
                    ndp[nsid] = v + row[y]
                    nkey[nsid] = r * A + y
                    parents[base + nsid] = ps

            # Assign lexicographic ranks to the best string for each state.
            items = [(nkey[sid] << 7) | sid for sid in rangeS if ndp[sid] < INF]
            items.sort()

            nrank = [0] * STATES
            prev_key = -1
            rnk = -1
            for item in items:
                key = item >> 7
                sid = item & 127
                if key != prev_key:
                    rnk += 1
                    prev_key = key
                nrank[sid] = rnk

            dp = ndp
            rank = nrank

        bestv = INF
        bestsid = -1
        bestr = INF

        for c in rangeA:
            sid = s3[c]
            v = dp[sid]
            if v < INF and (v < bestv or (v == bestv and rank[sid] < bestr)):
                bestv = v
                bestsid = sid
                bestr = rank[sid]

        if bestsid == -1:
            return ""

        res = [''] * n
        sid = bestsid

        for pos in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
            res[pos] = chars[sid // 3]
            sid = parents[pos * STATES + sid]

        res[0] = chars[sid // 3]
        return ''.join(res)

        n = len(caption)

        row = cost_table[arr[0]]

            dp[c*3] = row[c]
            rank[c*3] = c
        parents = [None]*n

        s3 = [c*3+2 for c in range(26)]

            row = cost_table[arr[i]]
            # best two
            b1v=INF; b1r=INF; b1s=-1; b1c=-1
            b2v=INF; b2r=INF; b2s=-1; b2c=-1
            for c in range(26):
                sid = s3[c]
                v = dp[sid]
                if v < INF:
                    r = rank[sid]
                    if v < b1v or (v == b1v and r < b1r):
                        b2v,b2r,b2s,b2c = b1v,b1r,b1s,b1c
                        b1v,b1r,b1s,b1c = v,r,sid,c
                    elif v < b2v or (v == b2v and r < b2r):
                        b2v,b2r,b2s,b2c = v,r,sid,c
            ndp = [INF]*78
            nkey = [INF_KEY]*78
            parent = bytearray(b'\xff') * 78
            # same
            for c in range(26):
                cost = row[c]
                sid = s1[c]
                v = dp[sid]
                if v < INF:
                    nsid = s2[c]
                    cand = v + cost
                    key = rank[sid]*26 + c
                    if cand < ndp[nsid] or (cand == ndp[nsid] and key < nkey[nsid]):
                        ndp[nsid] = cand
                        nkey[nsid] = key
                        parent[nsid] = sid
                sid = s2[c]
                v = dp[sid]
                if v < INF:
                    nsid = s3[c]
                    cand = v + cost
                    key = rank[sid]*26 + c
                    if cand < ndp[nsid] or (cand == ndp[nsid] and key < nkey[nsid]):
                        ndp[nsid] = cand
                        nkey[nsid] = key
                        parent[nsid] = sid
                sid = s3[c]
                v = dp[sid]
                if v < INF:
                    nsid = s3[c]
                    cand = v + cost
                    key = rank[sid]*26 + c
                    if cand < ndp[nsid] or (cand == ndp[nsid] and key < nkey[nsid]):
                        ndp[nsid] = cand
                        nkey[nsid] = key
                        parent[nsid] = sid
            # switch
            if b1s != -1:
                # local variables for speed
                for y in range(26):
                    if b1c != y:
                        v = b1v; r = b1r; ps = b1s
                    elif b2c != y:
                        v = b2v; r = b2r; ps = b2s
                    else:
                        continue
                    nsid = s1[y]
                    cand = v + row[y]
                    key = r*26 + y
                    if cand < ndp[nsid] or (cand == ndp[nsid] and key < nkey[nsid]):
                        ndp[nsid] = cand
                        nkey[nsid] = key
                        parent[nsid] = ps
            # ranks
            items = []
            append = items.append
            for sid in range(78):
                if ndp[sid] < INF:
                    append((nkey[sid] << 7) | sid)
            items.sort()
            nrank = [0]*78
            prev = -1
            r = -1
            for item in items:

                if key != prev:

        bestv=INF; bestsid=-1; bestr=INF

            return ""
        res = ['']*n
        sid = bestsid
        for pos in range(n-1, -1, -1):
            c = sid // 3
            res[pos] = chr(97+c)
            if pos:
                sid = parents[pos][sid]

Pseudo with single parents:
```
class Solution:
    def minCostGoodCaption(self, caption: str) -> str:
        n = len(caption)
        if n < 3:
            return ""
        INF = 10**9
        INF_KEY = 10**9
        cost_table = [[abs(i-j) for j in range(26)] for i in range(26)]
        arr = [ord(ch)-97 for ch in caption]
        s1 = [c*3 for c in range(26)]
        s2 = [c*3+1 for c in range(26)]
        s3 = [c*3+2 for c in range(26)]
        dp = [INF]*78
        rank = [0]*78
        row = cost_table[arr[0]]
        for c in range(26):
            dp[s1[c]] = row[c]
            rank[s1[c]] = c
        parents = bytearray(b'\xff') * (n * 78)
        range26 = range(26)
        range78 = range(78)
        for i in range(1, n):
            row = cost_table[arr[i]]
            # best two len3
            b1v = INF; b1r = INF; b1s = -1; b1c = -1
            b2v = INF; b2r = INF; b2s = -1; b2c = -1
            for c in range26:
                sid = s3[c]
                v = dp[sid]
                if v < INF:
                    r = rank[sid]
                    if v < b1v or (v == b1v and r < b1r):
                        b2v, b2r, b2s, b2c = b1v, b1r, b1s, b1c
                        b1v, b1r, b1s, b1c = v, r, sid, c
                    elif v < b2v or (v == b2v and r < b2r):
                        b2v, b2r, b2s, b2c = v, r, sid, c
            ndp = [INF] * 78
            nkey = [0] * 78
            base = i * 78
            # same transitions
            for c in range26:
                cost = row[c]
                sid1 = s1[c]
                v = dp[sid1]
                if v < INF:
                    nsid = s2[c]
                    ndp[nsid] = v + cost
                    nkey[nsid] = rank[sid1] * 26 + c
                    parents[base + nsid] = sid1
                sid2 = s2[c]
                sid3 = s3[c]
                v2 = dp[sid2]
                if v2 < INF:
                    cand2 = v2 + cost
                    key2 = rank[sid2] * 26 + c
                    ps2 = sid2
                else:
                    cand2 = INF
                    key2 = INF_KEY
                    ps2 = -1
                v3 = dp[sid3]
                if v3 < INF:
                    cand3 = v3 + cost
                    key3 = rank[sid3] * 26 + c
                    ps3 = sid3
                else:
                    cand3 = INF
                    key3 = INF_KEY
                    ps3 = -1
                if cand2 < cand3 or (cand2 == cand3 and key2 < key3):
                    if cand2 < INF:
                        ndp[sid3] = cand2
                        nkey[sid3] = key2
                        parents[base + sid3] = ps2
                else:
                    if cand3 < INF:
                        ndp[sid3] = cand3
                        nkey[sid3] = key3
                        parents[base + sid3] = ps3
            # switch transitions
            if b1s != -1:
                for y in range26:
                    if b1c != y:
                        v = b1v; r = b1r; ps = b1s
                    elif b2s != -1 and b2c != y:
                        v = b2v; r = b2r; ps = b2s
                    else:
                        continue
                    nsid = s1[y]
                    ndp[nsid] = v + row[y]
                    nkey[nsid] = r * 26 + y
                    parents[base + nsid] = ps
            # assign ranks
            items = [(nkey[sid] << 7) | sid for sid in range78 if ndp[sid] < INF]
            items.sort()
            nrank = [0] * 78
            prev_key = -1
            rnk = -1
            for item in items:
                key = item >> 7
                sid = item & 127
                if key != prev_key:
                    rnk += 1
                    prev_key = key
                nrank[sid] = rnk
            dp = ndp
            rank = nrank
        bestv = INF; bestsid = -1; bestr = INF
        for c in range26:
            sid = s3[c]
            v = dp[sid]
            if v < bestv or (v == bestv and rank[sid] < bestr):
                bestv = v; bestsid = sid; bestr = rank[sid]
        if bestsid == -1:
            return ""
        res = [''] * n
        sid = bestsid
        for pos in range(n-1, 0, -1):
            res[pos] = chr(97 + sid // 3)
            sid = parents[pos * 78 + sid]
        res[0] = chr(97 + sid // 3)
        return ''.join(res)

class Solution:
    def minCostGoodCaption(self, caption: str) -> str:
        n = len(caption)
        if n < 3:
            return ""
        A = 26
        STATES = A * 3
        INF = 10**9
        INF_KEY = 10**9
        rangeA = range(A)
        rangeS = range(STATES)
        cost_table = [[abs(i - j) for j in rangeA] for i in rangeA]
        arr = [ord(ch) - 97 for ch in caption]
        s1 = [c * 3 for c in rangeA]
        s2 = [c * 3 + 1 for c in rangeA]
        s3 = [c * 3 + 2 for c in rangeA]
        chars = [chr(97 + c) for c in rangeA]
        dp = [INF] * STATES
        rank = [0] * STATES
        row = cost_table[arr[0]]
        for c in rangeA:
            dp[s1[c]] = row[c]
            rank[s1[c]] = c
        parents = bytearray(b'\xff') * (n * STATES)
        for i in range(1, n):
            row = cost_table[arr[i]]
            b1v = INF; b1r = INF; b1s = -1; b1c = -1
            b2v = INF; b2r = INF; b2s = -1; b2c = -1
            for c in rangeA:
                sid = s3[c]
                v = dp[sid]
                if v < INF:
                    r = rank[sid]
                    if v < b1v or (v == b1v and r < b1r):
                        b2v, b2r, b2s, b2c = b1v, b1r, b1s, b1c
                        b1v, b1r, b1s, b1c = v, r, sid, c
                    elif v < b2v or (v == b2v and r < b2r):
                        b2v, b2r, b2s, b2c = v, r, sid, c
            ndp = [INF] * STATES
            nkey = [0] * STATES
            base = i * STATES
            for c in rangeA:
                cost = row[c]
                sid1 = s1[c]
                v = dp[sid1]
                if v < INF:
                    nsid = s2[c]
                    ndp[nsid] = v + cost
                    nkey[nsid] = rank[sid1] * A + c
                    parents[base + nsid] = sid1
                sid2 = s2[c]
                sid3 = s3[c]
                v2 = dp[sid2]
                if v2 < INF:
                    cand2 = v2 + cost
                    key2 = rank[sid2] * A + c
                    ps2 = sid2
                else:
                    cand2 = INF
                    key2 = INF_KEY
                    ps2 = -1
                v3 = dp[sid3]
                if v3 < INF:
                    cand3 = v3 + cost
                    key3 = rank[sid3] * A + c
                    ps3 = sid3
                else:
                    cand3 = INF
                    key3 = INF_KEY
                    ps3 = -1
                if cand2 < cand3 or (cand2 == cand3 and key2 < key3):
                    if cand2 < INF:
                        ndp[sid3] = cand2
                        nkey[sid3] = key2
                        parents[base + sid3] = ps2
                else:
                    if cand3 < INF:
                        ndp[sid3] = cand3
                        nkey[sid3] = key3
                        parents[base + sid3] = ps3
            if b1s != -1:
                for y in rangeA:
                    if b1c != y:
                        v = b1v; r = b1r; ps = b1s
                    elif b2s != -1 and b2c != y:
                        v = b2v; r = b2r; ps = b2s
                    else:
                        continue
                    nsid = s1[y]
                    ndp[nsid] = v + row[y]
                    nkey[nsid] = r * A + y
                    parents[base + nsid] = ps
            items = [(nkey[sid] << 7) | sid for sid in rangeS if ndp[sid] < INF]
            items.sort()
            nrank = [0] * STATES
            prev_key = -1
            rnk = -1
            for item in items:
                key = item >> 7
                sid = item & 127
                if key != prev_key:
                    rnk += 1
                    prev_key = key
                nrank[sid] = rnk
            dp = ndp
            rank = nrank
        bestv = INF; bestsid = -1; bestr = INF
        for c in rangeA:
            sid = s3[c]
            v = dp[sid]
            if v < bestv or (v == bestv and rank[sid] < bestr):
                bestv = v
                bestsid = sid
                bestr = rank[sid]
        if bestsid == -1:
            return ""
        res = [''] * n
        sid = bestsid
        for pos in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
            res[pos] = chars[sid // 3]
            sid = parents[pos * STATES + sid]
        res[0] = chars[sid // 3]
        return ''.join(res)

from typing import List

class Solution:
    def maxScore(self, points: List[int], m: int) -> int:
        n = len(points)

        # Not needed by the official constraints (n >= 2), but keeps the code safe.
        if n == 1:
            return points[0] if m >= 1 else 0

        # A positive minimum requires visiting every index at least once.
        if m < n:
            return 0

        N = n - 1  # number of edges between array indices
        NEG = -10**30

        def can(x: int, pts=points, mm=m, nn=n, NN=N) -> bool:
            if x == 0:
                return True

            # Required visits for each index.
            # Also use the necessary condition: total required visits <= moves.
            r = []
            append = r.append
            total = 0
            for idx, p in enumerate(pts):
                req = (x + p - 1) // p
                total += req
                # Every remaining index still needs at least one visit.
                if total + (nn - idx - 1) > mm:
                    return False
                append(req)

            # Special case: only two array positions.
            if NN == 1:
                a, b = r[0], r[1]

                # End at index 0.
                f = a - 1
                if b > f:
                    f = b
                if 1 + 2 * f <= mm:
                    return True

                # End at index 1.
                f = a - 1
                bm1 = b - 1
                if bm1 > f:
                    f = bm1
                if 2 + 2 * f <= mm:
                    return True

                return False

            # For a fixed ending index p, the minimum extra edge traversals
            # can be computed by a dual DP on a path.  We need the minimum
            # over all p.  Weights are "low" for indices <= p and "high"
            # for indices > p, so prefix/suffix DP gives all p in O(n).
            CAP = mm + 1

            # suffix DP for "high" weights.
            # suf0[i], suf1[i]: best suffix value from node i onward,
            # given previous edge state is 0 or 1.
            suf0 = [0] * (NN + 1)
            suf1 = [0] * (NN + 1)

            # Final lower bound for u_N when p < N.
            val = r[NN]
            if val > CAP:
                val = CAP
            suf0[NN] = val

            highL1 = r[0] - 1
            if highL1 < 1:
                highL1 = 1

            for i in range(NN - 1, 0, -1):
                highL = highL1 if i == 1 else 1
                highA = r[i]

                v0 = highL + suf0[i + 1]
                if v0 > CAP:
                    v0 = CAP
                v1 = highA + suf1[i + 1]
                if v1 > CAP:
                    v1 = CAP

                suf0[i] = v0 if v0 > v1 else v1
                suf1[i] = suf0[i + 1]

            # Prefix DP for "low" weights, evaluating every ending index p.
            pref0 = 0
            pref1 = NEG

            # p = 0: all weights are high.
            f = suf0[1]
            if 1 + 2 * f <= mm:
                return True

            lowL1 = r[0] - 1

            # p = 1 .. N-1
            for p in range(1, NN):
                lowL = lowL1 if p == 1 else 0
                lowA = r[p] - 1

                v0 = pref0 + lowL
                if v0 > CAP:
                    v0 = CAP
                new0 = v0 if v0 > pref1 else pref1

                v1 = pref0 + lowA
                if v1 > CAP:
                    v1 = CAP

                pref0, pref1 = new0, v1

                f0 = pref0 + suf0[p + 1]
                if f0 > CAP:
                    f0 = CAP
                f1 = pref1 + suf1[p + 1]
                if f1 > CAP:
                    f1 = CAP
                f = f0 if f0 > f1 else f1

                if 1 + p + 2 * f <= mm:
                    return True

            # p = N: all edge weights are low, final lower bound is low.
            lowLN = r[NN] - 1
            f0 = pref0 + lowLN
            if f0 > CAP:
                f0 = CAP
            f1 = pref1
            f = f0 if f0 > f1 else f1

            if 1 + NN + 2 * f <= mm:
                return True

            return False

        # Upper bound:
        # The minimum-points index needs ceil(ans / min(points)) visits,
        # and all other n-1 indices need at least one visit.
        lo = 0
        hi = min(points) * (m - n + 1) + 1

        while lo + 1 < hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            if can(mid):
                lo = mid
            else:
                hi = mid

        return lo
